At the same time the patient also began to have superimposed painful spasms and clonic contraction of her leg that lasted 10-15 sec and then resolved spontaneously. The increased tone also involve d the abdominal muscles, with opisthotonus, facial muscles with trismus and dysphagia, respiratory muscles with respiratory insufficiency: the patient was intubated and connected to the automatic ventilation.
